title: The source-text renderer, and prefetch on visibility and press

tasks.title: SourceText — fetch, validate, sanitise and render the text, gated on visibility

acs.text: WHEN `SourceText` is given a ref THE SYSTEM SHALL fetch it from the public text API (the reader page's origin, `/api/v3/texts/<ref>`, primary and translation, `return_format=text_only`), validate the answer with a schema, and render the first segments of the Hebrew and the English version, each in an element whose `lang` and `dir` come from that version's language and direction; Hebrew comes first in the Hebrew interface, English first in the English interface.
scenarios: Hebrew and English, each marked with its language and direction

acs.text: WHEN the text holds markup or entities THE SYSTEM SHALL render plain text only (tags removed, a few entities decoded, no element or attribute from the API in the DOM, never `innerHTML`); WHEN the answer fails the schema or the request fails THE SYSTEM SHALL show a short "text unavailable" line instead, without throwing.
scenarios: Markup from the API is rendered as text

acs.text: WHEN a card's text is not yet within 200px of the viewport THE SYSTEM SHALL not request it; when it comes that close the request starts; the same ref is requested at most once per page while its answer is cached.
scenarios: Fetch on visibility, once per ref

acs.text: WHEN the person presses a live room's card (pointer down, or Enter or Space on its focused link) THE SYSTEM SHALL prepare the room's session (one socket, a "prefetch" hold) so the room's place is in hand when the click lands, and release it after 10 seconds if no enlarge followed; without a press no socket opens (spec 016 AC-003 stays true).
